name: Franks Tract SRA
description: Franks Tract State Recreation Area is a flooded former Delta island near Bethel Island, surrounded by marsh and remnant levees. It is almost completely underwater and can only be reached by boat.
fullDescription: Franks Tract State Recreation Area is a flooded former Delta island near Bethel Island, surrounded by marsh and remnant levees. It is almost completely underwater and can only be reached by boat.
whatTheyOffer:
- Fishing, including a popular striped bass fly-fishing area
- Bird watching, especially waterfowl in fall and winter
- Seasonal waterfowl hunting on part of the open water (arranged in advance through the Diablo Range District Office)
- No camping, restrooms, or land facilities
howToGetIt: Franks Tract is only accessible by water, southeast of Brannan Island between False River and Bethel Island. No entrance fee is listed. Dogs are not allowed. Call the Delta Sector at 925-447-0426 for information.
address: Harbor Rd (and boat-in), Bethel Island, CA, 94561
keywords: Franks Tract, state recreation area, Bethel Island, Delta, fishing, boating, boat-in, wetlands
